title: VK-only Read File Record: In libmodbus/tests/unit-test-server, requests with incorrect length field values were accepted
purpose: Reach the issue-relevant parser path through a plausible deeper protocol structure

messages.label: Repeated Read File Record request with alternate file and record

expected_behavior: Each request should be parsed as a complete Read File Record transaction; a compliant server may return file-record data or a defined exception for unavailable references
constraints_preserved: Each message has a 7-byte MBAP header
MBAP lengths equal the unit identifier plus the complete PDU
Read File Record byte count matches the nested record descriptor
Nested reference type, file number, record number, and record length fields are present
issue_safety_notes: The sequence explores length-field and parser-depth relations reported in the evidence without reproducing any exact historical trigger bytes. Model-prior field semantics are not externally verified
